body.x: Carbon T&C Co., Ltd. (CEO Gun Soo Kim) announced its participation in CES 2025, which will be held in Las Vegas from January 7 to 10. The company will exhibit at the K-Startup Pavilion, presenting its advanced carbon nanomaterial technologies.

Specializing in advanced carbon nanomaterials such as carbon nanotubes (CNT) and graphene, CARBON T&C focuses on dispersion and coating technologies. The company highlights its ability to effectively disperse carbon nanomaterials in various solvents and coat them onto the surfaces of cathodes and anodes. This approach minimizes the use of conductive additives, increases active material density, and enhances electrical conductivity, ultimately boosting the energy density of lithium-ion battery electrodes.

CARBON T&C is advancing next-generation electrode manufacturing by addressing challenges in conductive additive dispersion in dry electrode production. The company’s carbon nanomaterial coating technology ensures uniform distribution, solving uneven dispersion issues and enabling the production of high-performance and efficient batteries.

“A uniform coating of carbon nanotubes or graphene on the active material surface maximizes the material’s conductive properties while reducing the required amount of conductive additives,” explained a company representative. “This increases electrode energy density and simplifies powder mixing processes for battery manufacturers, allowing them to produce batteries with higher energy densities.”

The representative added, “Companies like Tesla, LG Energy Solution, and Samsung SDI are leading the early adoption of dry electrode production methods, and other battery manufacturers are actively exploring this approach. CARBON T&C collaborates with select manufacturers to adopt dry electrodes and leverage our coating technology. We are also working with POSCO Holdings to develop carbon nanomaterial-coated products and plan to introduce new active materials that set a benchmark in lithium-ion batteries.”

AVING News, which has covered CES for 19 consecutive years, continues to bridge the gap for Korean SMEs and startups looking to expand globally. To promote Korean startups worldwide, AVING will host its Broadcasting Zone at the Venetian Expo, featuring the CES Media Day Startup Conference and global media interviews. AVING’s international media partners will cover these programs.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host review conferences with participating companies in Korea, offering a platform for increased visibility and improved corporate image.
